note: Budgets for the web build (dist/) and the content pack (dist-content/), checked by `npm run package:check`. precacheMiB is what the service worker downloads on first launch (everything not lazy); audio packs and non-abode Longtime chunks are fetched on first use (pwa/vite-plugin.ts), audioMiB caps all audio shipped. Atlas chunk caps are the LONGTIME_GDD.md table (mobile pages / MiB of decompressed RGBA8); the core atlas cap is 26 MiB (game-plan 5.3 set 24.5 = 6 x 1024x1024 + 1024x128 pages; PX-1 hurt clips (84 frames) and enemy projectiles grew the last page to 1024x512, owner/orchestrator to confirm).
